Trump claims vandalism for reflecting pool issues, plans golf course work

Former US President Donald Trump has attributed the green color and peeling paint of Washington's Reflecting Pool to vandalism, though he has not provided evidence. He also announced plans for renovations to the East Potomac Golf Links, with work expected to begin in September. The reflecting pool's issues have arisen despite recent renovation costs.
